manifest.rights: INALCO booklet text is used ONLY as a cross-check signal and as short factual tags (theme names, radical French names). No booklet compounds, examples, or gloss lines are copied into this file.
manifest.checkRule: meaningFrCheck: content-token sets (lowercase, accents stripped, French stopwords + single letters dropped) of the booklet gloss vs KANJIDIC2 meaningsFr; agrees when |A∩B| / min(|A|,|B|) ≥ 0.5, differs below that, null when either side has no French text. A QA signal, not a correctness verdict — synonyms in different words score differs.
